Name: JM Matcha Tabletop Decorations
Author: jawesome9235
Description:
# JM Matcha Tabletop Decorations

Bring a little Japanese tea-house charm to your farmhouse with 30 matcha-themed tabletop decorations: delicate tea tools, green tea sweets, celadon ceramics and small animal figurines. Matcha green, soft ivory and pale bamboo tones tie the collection together. Each item uses a detailed 64×64 pixel-art sprite and fits a 1×1 tile footprint.

## Features

- 30 new decorative furniture items with a coordinated matcha palette and a Stardew-inspired pixel-art style.
- Place decorations on empty tables or on the floor.
- Get every item free from Robin's Furniture Catalogue, or buy individual pieces from Robin's shop.
- Refined proportions: small treats and ornaments leave more space on the tabletop, while larger jars and vases retain their presence.
- Clear inventory icons, independently sized from the furniture's tabletop artwork.
- Automatic names in English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, German, French, Japanese and Korean.
- English fallback for other game languages. All names keep the JM- prefix.
- One installation folder, with artwork, translations and code included together.

## What's included?

Tea tools and drinks: Matcha Tea Bowl, Bamboo Tea Whisk, Tea Scoop and Matcha Dish, Matcha Tea Tin, Celadon Tea Cup Pair, Matcha Preparation Set, Glass Tea Leaf Jar, Small Cast Iron Teapot, Hot Matcha Latte, Matcha Milk Bottle, Tea Cloth and Bamboo Tray, and Celadon Water Jar.

Sweets and treats: Strawberry Matcha Daifuku, Three-Color Dango, Matcha Swiss Roll, Matcha Mille Crepe Cake, Matcha Dorayaki, Matcha Taiyaki, Matcha Cookie Tin, Matcha Ice Cream Bowl, Matcha Baumkuchen and Matcha Nama Chocolate Box.

Greenery and tea-house ornaments: Kokedama Moss Garden, Celadon Camellia Vase, Miniature Zen Garden, Tea Incense Warmer and Tea House Sign.

Animal figurines: Matcha Lucky Cat, Tea House Tanuki and Green Ceramic Bird.

## Requirements

Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.1.10 or later. No Content Patcher, Custom Furniture or ScaleUp dependency is required.

## Installation

1. Install SMAPI if you don't already have it.
2. Close the game and download the main file.
3. Extract the single JM Matcha Decorations folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

To update from an earlier version, back up your save and replace the old JM Matcha Decorations folder. Keep only one copy installed. Version 1.0.1 preserves all existing furniture IDs, so decorations already placed in your save do not need to be purchased again.

## Getting and placing your decorations

Open Robin's Furniture Catalogue to claim the items for free. This is the furniture catalogue, rather than Pierre's wallpaper and flooring catalogue. Individual items are also available in Robin's shop.

Hold a decoration and use the normal placement action on an empty table. The mod follows the game's standard one-display-item-per-table rule. Remove the existing display item first if the table is occupied. You can also place these decorations on the floor.

## Languages

Names follow the game's selected language automatically. Seven languages are included in the same download: English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, German, French, Japanese and Korean. Unsupported languages and missing translation entries fall back to English.

## Compatibility and scope

This mod adds its own furniture IDs and preserves the original shop stock. Content registration and drawing are handled by one SMAPI mod. It draws its 64×64 artwork directly, so ScaleUp is unnecessary. Compatibility with every furniture or rendering mod has not been tested.

JM Cozy Tabletop Decorations is an optional companion mod, not a requirement. The two collections use separate item IDs, artwork paths and diagnostic commands. Automated checks confirmed that both collections can register together, providing 65 catalogue items in total; full in-game testing of the combined setup has not been completed.

These are static decorations. Food and drinks cannot be consumed, tea tools do not provide crafting functions, and the incense warmer does not produce smoke or other effects. Each item has one orientation.

Before uninstalling, remove these custom decorations from your save and make a backup.
